Proyeksi tidak memberikan izin akses. Ji: Projection does not grant access permission. Projection also does not guarantee that the contents are correct when the source data is wrong. A query can select the right columns from the wrong rows if its filter, join, or business key is incorrect. That is why this lesson deliberately discusses result shape rather than the security and validation of the whole application.

Miskonsepsi ketiga adalah mengira daftar: The third misconception is that a column list automatically gives rows an order. SELECT determines columns, not record order.
